research_question: After immutable capability replication is removed, how should worker count be selected when queueing/progress and residual process residency move in different directions?

hosted_proxy.capability_placement: read-only shared mmap prefaulted before start barrier
hosted_proxy.run_order: ascending worker counts then descending worker counts

primary_oracles: all job digests are stable across repetitions
all job digests are stable across worker counts
all measured cost dimensions are positive where defined
the measured Pareto frontier is non-empty
no worker count is preregistered as the winner
no scalar gain is emitted without an external price or hard constraint
nonclaims: The observed fastest worker count is not a universal optimum.
The observed lowest-PSS worker count is not a universal optimum.
This batch hashing proxy is not application throughput for Strata, PCG, or AI workers.
Shared mmap does not eliminate page-fault, cache, coordination, or contention costs.
Capability availability does not grant execution authority.
selection_rule: Use the measured typed frontier plus explicit caller constraints or prices; do not maximize worker count by default.
next_falsifier: Add finite memory pressure and phase fault-in so worker count and residency policy must be chosen jointly rather than as independent knobs.
